cases.disease: COL4A1-related cerebral small vessel disease (late-onset ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke, leukoencephalopathy)
cases.mechanism_detail: Heterozygous intronic Alu insertion in COL4A1 intron 16 in a 64-year-old with a COL4A1-compatible phenotype; no functional or RNA evidence presented in the abstract.
cases.quote: Genetic testing revealed COL4A1 gene mutation of heterozygous Alu insertion at intron 16.
